column8: The package BUILD target maps terror_test.go to the dedicated terror_source Rust target; the complete build metadata has a checked support disposition and declares no fixture or generated-source obligation.
Both asserted source values are exact, and machine-width minimum and maximum values prevent a narrowed Rust domain.

All fixed and dynamic classes, registration and freeze, generation variants, exact rendering, SQL conversion, class lookup, global prototypes, and wrapped equality are exercised over the shared authority.

Serde emits and accepts the exact pingcap/errors class/code/message/rfccode object, including the no-RFC compatibility row, escaping, legacy class restoration, and the historical struct versus structure boundary.
Root-cause traversal, nil equality, equal ordinary messages, and RFC inequality for same-code/different-class and same-class/different-code errors are exact.
None and present-error logging plus Call success and error paths execute against the tracing-backed Rust helper without propagation.
GenWithStack captures a native Rust backtrace and the test requires the source-shaped terror call site to be present; the package does not claim Go runtime frame formatting.

Every original test function and package build target is represented, with additional regressions for dynamic registration, freeze, MustNil cleanup-before-exit, complete JSON compatibility, machine-width values, and unknown classes.
